evidenceBoundary: Public official documentation and repository descriptions only. GitHub verifies CharHubAI controls chub.ai; stage-template links to docs.chub.ai. Direct command-line access to chub.ai returned "This service is not available in your country." No account, purchases, inference calls, preview/browser automation, production access, or hands-on chat/device tests. Benefits are explicitly untested design inferences. Unknown means not established, not absent.

strengths.mechanism: Separate reader-facing metadata, scenario, definitions and alternate greetings.
strengths.benefitInference: May help readers understand the premise and select an opening without adding creator notes to the prompt.

strengths.mechanism: Full chat tree plus named conversations listed per character.
strengths.benefitInference: May help writers retain competing continuations and distinguish separate runs.

strengths.mechanism: Editable Chat Memory and keyword-triggered lore with budgets and priorities.
strengths.benefitInference: May let writers correct remembered facts and allocate limited context to relevant setting information. No continuity guarantee was tested.

strengths.mechanism: Separate Configuration, Secrets and Character Settings; model-specific presets and user chat edits.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce accidental changes to the shared character and make model-dependent settings reusable. Exact cross-chat edit propagation is untested.

tradeoffs: Documented connection setup, prompt fields and generation parameters may burden first use; this is an untested design inference.
Character-specific system/post-history instructions and characterbooks depend on Use V2 Spec.; disabled prerequisites can affect expected behavior.
Prompting warns assistant prefill may cause API errors. Recovery and failed-input retention were not established.
Share/Unshare Chat creates an anonymized link and a shared public chat entry. This is public distribution, not established confidentiality.
JSONL export labeled for SillyTavern is documented, but migration fidelity and full branch preservation were not tested.
Local model connections and a stage extension repository do not establish self-hosting of the full application.
Direct command-line access to chub.ai was geographically blocked in this research environment. Global availability rules were not established.
unknowns: Current deployed parity with the documentation; documentation image filenames include 2023 and 2025 dates.
Current mobile app availability, narrow-screen behavior, touch operation, accessibility and keyboard behavior.
Exact outgoing request/context inspector and visibility into which lore entries were actually sent.
Message editing and retry mechanics; full historical-state recovery including settings and memory.
Character and chat import steps, bulk export, branch and metadata preservation, migration round-trip fidelity.
Failure recovery, retention of failed input and service reliability.
Current voice catalog, dictation and image-provider controls.
Full Chub application self-hosting and exact propagation of user chat character edits across separate stories.
reusablePatterns: Proposal: place a readable premise and selectable opening beside the start-story action.
Proposal: expose existing branch operations through a navigable tree with story names.
Proposal: show an editable current summary and identify the history it covers.
Proposal: label preset ownership, connection settings and character-edit scope at the decision point.
doNotCopy: Do not hide effects of Use V2 Spec. prerequisites from affected fields.
Do not imply anonymized public sharing is private.
Do not equate local-model connections or an extension SDK with application self-hosting.
Do not treat these proposals as evidence that the fork lacks its existing native capabilities.

characterOnboarding.note: Create Character separates metadata and definitions; description and initial message are required. Alternate greetings are documented. Exact character import workflow not established.

storyOrganization.note: New Chat, All Chats for the current character, editable chat names and View Full Chat Tree are documented. Exact historical-state restoration and global archive organization unverified.

editRetryBranch.note: Full chat branching and revisiting alternate swipes are documented. User chat character definitions can be changed. Message editing and retry controls were not established.

memoryLore.note: Manual/generated Chat Memory plus lorebook keyword activation, scan depth, token budget, priority and recursive scanning. Characterbooks require Use V2 Spec.

promptTransparency.note: Prompt sections, context-window limit, macros and ordering are explained. This does not establish an exact outgoing request inspector.

modelConnections.note: OpenAI, Anthropic, Mars, Kobold/Ooba, OpenRouter, Google and NovelAI connections are listed. Current integration operation untested.

advancedControls.note: Model-specific presets; system/post-history/impersonation prompts; temperature, Top K, Top P and penalties; prompt macros and prefill. Provider caveats apply.

groupRoleplay.note: Chat Settings can add characters. Turn scheduling and large-group behavior unverified.

imagesVoice.note: Imagine image generation inside chat and text-to-speech configuration are documented. Voice catalog, dictation and image controls unknown.

mobile.note: Official stage-template README claims iOS/Android platform support. No current distribution or mobile usability verification; documentation image filenames include older dates.

portability.note: Chat export as JSONL labeled SillyTavern, PNG or text. Exact import procedures, bulk movement and branch/metadata fidelity unknown.

selfHosting.note: Kobold/Ooba permits connecting a locally hosted model; stage-template is an extension template. Neither establishes self-hosting the full Chub application.
